c74object.name: evi.squine.simple~
c74object.digest: A basic implementation of Rasmus Ekman's 'squine wave' oscillator with audio rate modulation
c74object.description:
evi.squine.simple~ is a 'max define' for the evi_squine_simple.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.squine.simple~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
An extremely versatile phase modulation oscillator which can morph shape and does not alias (up to a certain point). Inlets are available for linear and logarithmic FM modulation, as well as optionally audio rate control over the shape morphing.

inlet.digest: Inlet #1: Freq in Hz or Pitch
inlet.description: Oscillator frequency in Hz (default) or Pitch depending on @freqmode attribute.
FM the oscillator frequency, in Pitch units.
FM the oscillator frequency, in Hz units.

One of two main wave shaping controls along with inlet 5. Harmonics normalised 0..1. At 0, no harmonics are added and the output is sine-wave-like (if inlet 5 'duty cycle' is set at it's default 0.5). Increasing this value gradually adds harmonics to the waveform as it morphs from sine-like to square-wave-like.
One of two main wave shaping controls along with inlet 4. PWM normalised 0..1. Shifts the waveform from negative to positive saw-wave-like through the shape created by inlet 4 ('harmonics').

outlet.description: Oscillator phase sync 0..1 post phase modulation.

attribute.name: freqmode
attribute.description: Switch oscillator frequency (inlet 1) units between input in Pitch (on) or input in Hz (off, default).

attribute.name: freqmul
attribute.description: Multiplier of samplerate to set maximum frequency input. Typically this would be lower than samplerate/4 (0.25).

attribute.name: freqsmooth
attribute.description: Smooth frequency input (inlet 1) by this amount in ms. Note that it is safe to smooth this evern if audio rate modulating using inlets 2 and 3 as summing is post smooth.

c74object.discussion: Thanks to Volker Böhm who suggested the simple block to emulate the oscillator concept in GenExpr code.
